high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram story posted by a user named "deomanish." The post was made 11 hours prior to the screenshot being taken on Tuesday, May 27th at 10:21 PM. The user has added their location as Mumbai. The main content of the story features a monorail train traveling along a curved track elevated above a cityscape. The monorail is green and black, with the words "Mumbai Monorail" written on its front. The track is supported by concrete structures, and the monorail is moving through a curve in the track.
